headline: New Bluetooth spec promises faster data speeds for 2027 devices
summary: Bluetooth's new High Data Throughput (HDT) feature, part of the Bluetooth 7 core specification, offers significantly higher bandwidth for wireless devices. Reports describe a maximum of 7.5 Mbps, enabling uses such as large lossless audio files, with the specification also expected to simplify smart home device setup.

claims.statement: Bluetooth is getting a new High Data Throughput (HDT) feature that will make devices significantly faster.
